name: Sarah
notes: Has coeliac disease, so everything must be fully gluten-free: no wheat, barley, rye or regular soy sauce (tamari is fine) and no normal pasta or bread unless it's a gluten-free version. Cooks for herself, a partner and two kids aged 5 and 8 who won't eat anything spicy or anything with visible onion or 'green bits'. Weeknights are hectic, so slow-cooker or traybake recipes are ideal.
